title: Session Restore
skipped: {n} more are skipped by your nirinit config.
restoring: Restoring… windows open one by one, this can take a minute.
undo_failed: Could not bring the session back
running: nirinit is running and saving your windows.
not_running: nirinit is not running, so nothing is being saved.

widget.pending: A saved session is waiting ({n} windows)
widget.not_running: Session Restore: nirinit is not running

hide_when_idle.label: Hide the icon when idle
hide_when_idle.description: Show the bar icon only while a saved session is waiting.

auto_open.label: Open at login
auto_open.description: Open the panel by itself when a saved session is waiting.

cfg.ask_hint: A saved session waits until you choose Restore, Start fresh or Later.
cfg.auto_hint: Windows reopen at login without asking, like plain nirinit.
cfg.interval_hint: 0 uses the value in niri's autostart line. Applies at next login.
cfg.bad_interval: Enter a whole number of seconds (0 to 86400).
cfg.skip_hint: Matched by app id. Terminals and apps that restore their own windows belong here.
cfg.next_login: Changes to this list apply the next time nirinit starts (next login). A backup is kept as config.toml.bak.
